title: Stone Soup radar tracking of two UAVs with JPDA and OSPA
summary: Simulates two small UAVs observed by a noisy bearing/range radar with clutter and tracks them with Stone Soup's Extended Kalman filter and JPDA data association. Track quality is scored against ground truth with the OSPA metric, the detect-and-track layer of a counter-UAS airspace picture.
verified: ran radar_jpda_ospa.py with stonesoup 1.9.1, numpy 2.5.4, scipy 1.18.1 on Python 3.12.14 on 2026-11-06: 2 tracks held on 2 truths, OSPA mean 17.0 m / max 53.0 m (c=100 m), identical over 3 runs after fixing set-ordering nondeterminism; output in README. Single seed and scenario, no Monte Carlo; initiators/deleters and live radar input not exercised.
